title: Tee times: 11 to 1, Norman then RTJ
content: Every group goes out between 11:00 AM and 1:00 PM on both days of golf. Day 1 is on the Norman Course and Day 2 is on the Robert Trent Jones 2 Course. Which slot you get depends on the draw, so the exact tee times are announced on Thursday night at the Pairings Party, once the pairings are made. Until then, plan on an 11 o'clock first tee at the earliest and a 1 o'clock at the latest. The three days are laid out in [Schedule](#schedule).

title: Putting faces to the names
content: The Teams page now carries a player card for everyone: a photograph, the hometown and, where we have it, the school. Forty-six of the fifty-two have a picture so far - from Royal Wootton Bassett, Blackburn and Banbury to Seoul, Pohang, Alice Springs, Dar-es-Salaam, Waldweiler, St. Petersburg, Houston, Chicago, Cincinnati, Toronto, Vienna, Boston and Atlanta. Use Detailed or Simple at the top of each squad to switch between the cards and the plain list. If yours is still missing, send a photograph and the town you grew up in. Have a look in [Teams](#teams).

title: Rosters are live, and a first for the Cup
content: Team USA and Team International are now published in full. Twenty-six players a side, with the International squad drawn from ten countries. This year also brings a first in the Cup's history: women are on both teams, and day one will feature the event's first female pairings. The field grows to thirteen pairings per side. Have a look in [Teams](#teams).
